div.p: Restrictions are additive: if any active rule blocks an operation, it is blocked. Superuser, sudo automation, and explicit RBAC bypass context remain exempt. Changes take effect immediately on publish.
This will permanently remove the rule and all its restrictions. Any hidden menus or access blocks applied by this rule will be lifted after reload.
